tagline: STIHL and ride-on mowers for Hamilton locals
heroSubheading: Expert advice and service for your outdoor power equipment.
aboutHtml:
We're Joel and Alex Hansen, running STIHL SHOP Hamilton East for our community. We stock STIHL equipment and ride-on mowers from Masport, Cub Cadet, Hansa, Hustler, Stiga, and Wright Stander. Whether you need a new tool, servicing, parts, or advice on what will work for your place, we're here to help without the hard sell.

We support Tamahere School, Womens' Refuge Waikato, and St. Johns Ambulance because that's what local businesses should do.

Come in and see us. We're open Monday to Friday 7:30am to 5pm, Saturday 9am to 4pm, and Sunday 9am to 3pm. We offer Click and Collect and home delivery for online orders too.
